title: Screening calibration: recovered provenance dispute and limits of the formulas
statement: The historical 120,000-game mirror calibration has unresolved primary provenance in the recovered chain. An August 22 audit already recorded the missing manifest and an unmerged scaling correction. The published table and scaling law differ. Two SRI restatements also change the mathematics: the per-arm Bernoulli SE coefficient and a lower-bound-below-zero kill criterion.
critical_context: Read reported empirical SDs as unresolved historical assertions. The nearby 6,000-game v000_baseline receipt is a different measurement and was later marked UNREAD. No public seed setter does not prove independent arms. No new sample allocation or scientific retraction is authorized; 2.199pp is not reinstated.

method.text: Read pinned sources and the earlier provenance audit; independently recalculate the published CI/MDE products, scaling law, Bernoulli SE and retained 6,000-game block summaries. Preserve the unmerged correction separately, without adopting its rule.

results.text: Table-based MDEs reproduce (9.8812/7.056/4.5528pp at 400/1200/2400 per arm). The stated scaling law instead gives sigma 4.3648pp at 400 and 1.7819pp at 2400. Its nominal 14.81pp MDE solution is N=272.388 (273 whole games/arm), not 180. Independent Bernoulli arms at p=.5 use SE=100*sqrt(.5/N)pp, so N=400 yields 3.5355pp; 100/sqrt(N) would be correct if N meant the combined total, contrary to the SRI definition. CI [-1,+1] crosses zero despite a negative lower bound.

lessons.text: An equation that checks algebraically is not a recovered empirical calibration. Keep per-arm versus total N, sampling unit, population, controls and operational stopping decisions distinct from evidence of benefit or harm.

next_question.text: Locate a source-bound producer/run manifest for the claimed 120k calibration, or keep it unresolved. Correct the SRI restatements at their curated source. Future sizing requires a declared design and target effect; new games remain paused.

limitations: No exhaustive disk/host scan; failure to recover provenance does not prove the120k run never happened.
No original 120k outcomes or game generator was executed. Recomputed 6000-game block rates do not substitute for that run.
Unmerged b139264419 is historical evidence, not current protocol or a new conservative allocation.
The Bernoulli formula assumes independent games/arms; covariance and clustered designs need their own variance analysis.
No gameplay, training, engine/model/provider calls, publication or policy change.
